items.title: Journey to a Strange World
items.summary: A solo exhibition presenting stories carried by skies, seas, and imagined beings.

content.text: The exhibition brings together stories carried by skies, seas, and imagined beings.
Visitors are invited into the quiet landscapes and lingering emotions created by the works.
